cues.zh: ## 关于7纳米
cues.en: ## Thinking About 7 Nanometers

cues.en: First, we need to go through this whole song and dance about the meaning of "7 nanometers".

cues.zh: 再说一遍：制程节点数字是营销手段，试图传达芯片在功耗、
cues.en: Here it is again: Process node numbers are marketing devices that try to convey a better

cues.zh: 性能或面积上的更优表现。
cues.en: chip in either Power, Performance, or Area.

cues.zh: 严格来说，“7 纳米”这个说法毫无意义。
cues.en: Literally speaking, the "7 nanometers" phrase means nothing.

cues.zh: 它并不对应任何物理尺寸。
cues.en: It does not correspond to any physical dimension.

cues.zh: 它只是说，这种芯片的性能比上一代 10 纳米芯片高出 70%
cues.en: It simply says that the chips are 70% better than the previous generation 10 nanometer

cues.zh: 而已。
cues.en: chips.

cues.zh: 而上一代 14 纳米芯片又比更早一代高出 70%。
cues.en: Which in turn are 70% better than the previous generation 14 nanometer chips.

cues.zh: 如此类推。
cues.en: And so on.

cues.zh: 为避免争议，台积电把 7 纳米节点称为 N7。
cues.en: To avoid controversy, TSMC calls their 7 nanometer node, N7.

cues.zh: 都不得不采用这种技术。
cues.en: had to resort to before EUV came out.

cues.en: device from ASML to use it.

cues.en: But the United States has placed an export ban on this technology, blocking this part

cues.en: of the roadmap.

cues.zh: 毫无疑问。
cues.en: No question.
